messages:
Irene: Quick heads-up — Ben submitted his resignation this morning. Last day is next Friday. Can we confirm payroll cutoff, benefits end date, and IT access removal schedule? cc @Alex @Priya
Alex: On payroll — I'll own the cutoff. Final paycheck will be prorated to last day; need Ben's timesheet submitted by EOD Wednesday so payroll can run. Payroll email: payroll@redwood.com
Priya: Got it. I'll prepare the separation packet and send COBRA enrollment link today. Note from broker: COBRA election window is 60 days from termination date. I'll also schedule the exit interview (10–15m).
IT Helpdesk: Opening a deprovision ticket now. We usually disable SSO at 6:00pm PT on the last day, then revoke all API keys and 3rd-party app tokens. Laptop return: we can arrange courier pickup or drop-off at HQ.
IT-Bot: Ticket created: IT-8421. Actions queued: remove-sso ben@redwood.com; revoke-keys ben@redwood.com; schedule-pickup IT-8421.estimate: 48h
Jordan: Security note — rotate any shared secrets Ben had access to (DB, KMS). I'll take ownership of DB creds rotation. Please list service accounts he used.
Irene: Ben is on infra oncall rotation for two services. Alex — can you take over pager until we backfill? Also approving a short 3-day access extension for handoff would help if security signs off.
Alex: I can pick up oncall for those services next week. Payroll side ok with 3-day extension for final knowledge transfer, but need security approval to keep access after termination.
Priya: Confirmed: healthcare and 401(k) contributions stop on termination date; COBRA and 401k rollover instructions will be in the packet. Final PTO payout follows policy HR-04 — will be included in final check if payout requested in the separation form.
Irene: For clarity — action items: 1) Priya sends separation packet + COBRA link, 2) Payroll receives timesheet by Wed, 3) IT schedules deprovision for last day 6pm PT, 4) Jordan rotates secrets, 5) Courrier pickup scheduled.
IT Helpdesk: Quick commands we run (internal):
```
# deprovision user
./deprovision.sh --email ben@redwood.com --revoke-keys --disable-sso
# schedule pickup
./courier schedule --user ben --pickup-date 2026-04-06
```
Irene: Ben requested ability to keep read-only access to docs for two business days to finish handoff. Can we do read-only ACL change instead of full deprovision?
Jordan: Read-only for Drive/docs is ok for 48h, but no access to production consoles or secrets. Security approves conditional read-only for 48h.
Priya: I'll note that in the separation packet and add an approval checkbox for limited access.
Alex: Reminder to managers: submit equipment return checklist (serial numbers) to asset@redwood.com or courier form.
IT Helpdesk: Pickup link: https://intranet.redwood/courier-form — put ticket ID IT-8421. We'll do a wipe and asset inventory once returned.
Priya: I'll run the exit interview and capture any feedback. If Ben elects COBRA, broker will email enrollment steps within 48 hours of receiving termination notice.
Irene: Thanks all. I'll consolidate into an email and post the final checklist here by EOD. :thumbsup:
